images.caption: Built in the late 19th Century, these commercial buildings feature Queen Anne-style details including an oriel window, recessed brick panels, brick corbeling, pilasters, and a bracketed cornice.  The

brief: Pair of late-19th-century two-storey Queen Anne brick commercial buildings: recessed brick panels, corbelled cornices, pilasters and a projecting oriel window upstairs; small shop fronts, one with an awning. Record gap: 1 photo of these buildings (the rest of the set shows neighbours).

floors: W W W Wb W W W
facade.notes: Court Street (Bowling Green OH, 1890s): three two-storey brick fronts of different heights, a pent roof on one, an oriel on another, a corbelled metal cornice and copper awning on the third; offices in the shopfronts; parked cars

why.note: the two-part block: shops below, offices or flats above
different fronts held together by the shared setback, height band and bay rhythm
